<thought>To design a ≤3‑step synthesis, I will disconnect the target at the sulfonamide N–S bond and at the amide C–N bond. This gives two commercially available precursors: (1) p‑toluenesulfonyl chloride (TsCl) and (2) the aniline that already contains the trans‑cinnamoyl‑amide side chain. The latter can be made in one step by coupling 4‑aminocinnamic acid (commercial) with p‑phenylenediamine (commercial). Thus the overall route is two steps:  
Step 1 – Amide coupling of 4‑aminocinnamic acid and p‑phenylenediamine → intermediate B (4‑(E)‑3‑(4‑aminophenyl)acrylamide).  
Step 2 – Sulfonylation of the free aniline of B with p‑toluenesulfonyl chloride → target molecule.  

I will locate suitable retrosynthetic templates for (i) amide formation (acid + amine) and (ii) sulfonamide formation (sulfonyl chloride + amine) using the template catalog, then construct the JSON route using those template IDs.
